svg.text: COMPLETE PROJECT ECOSYSTEM — TalentSphere, as built
Reverse-engineered from the repository: 2,188 nodes · 5,582 typed edges · every node carries file:line evidence · status and confidence assigned · nothing executed (no HIGH confidence)
apps/worker · Background-job worker (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
config, contracts, domain, observability, testing, ui
CANDIDATE: Dashboard, Jobs, Applications, Work history, Messa…

role gates inside pages: AdminPage, HiringPage
INPUT → schema parse → rule → branch → persist | Do…
local useState per page · no query/state library
apiJson: 20 s timeout, ApiError with server message
rate limit (user id or IP) · helmet · CORS
storage mode pg | memory (no silent fallback)
claim: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED + lease fence
only 2 job kinds deliver; 43 record only
31 status unions without a transition rule
template standing in for an integration
RELATIONSHIPS (edge styles in the DOT / drawio graph)
Each card is one of the 20 required branches; the footer names its detail file.
Boxed headings are sub-branches; dots show the implementation status of the item.
Every item is a node (or a count of nodes) in master/MASTER_PROJECT_GRAPH.json:
PROJ ROLE JOUR MOD FEAT API SCR COMP INT ERR RULE SCH SVC DB STATE TEST EXT INFRA
Curves from the hub show the three groups; the chain below shows real cross-connections.
Full graph (nothing truncated): GRAPH.json · GRAPH.dot · per-module subgraphs.
Journeys come from e2e tests; tests were not executed → confidence is MEDIUM at best.
